_comment: X Lists are the backbone of collection. One public List = one HTTP request that returns ~68 recent posts across up to ~78 authors, live to the minute. Profile timelines cannot do this: they are per-account cached and some are frozen for months. Create these Lists on your X account, set each to PUBLIC, and paste the numeric id from the list URL (x.com/i/lists/<ID>) below. Run `npm run plan-lists` to print exactly which handles belong in each list.
_sharding_rule: Each List returns only ~68 posts with no pagination, so a List must be small enough that 68 posts covers your poll interval. At a 10-minute cadence, keep each List to roughly 40-60 accounts and split the noisy ones (national aggregators) away from the quiet ones (state scouts) so a burst on one does not bury the other.

lists.name: ow-reporters
lists.note: National recruiting reporters + services. Highest precision, highest volume.

lists.name: ow-schools-a
lists.note: FBS program accounts, first half (see plan-lists output).

lists.name: ow-state-scouts
lists.note: State/regional scouting accounts. Lower volume, earliest signal on unranked kids.

lists.name: ow-players-1
lists.note: Promoted player accounts from data/watchlist.json. Re-run plan-lists periodically and top this up.
